source_row.acip: 'DI LA, ,GSUM LAM BDUN NI LAS KYANG YIN,
source_row.wylie: 'di la, ,gsum lam bdun ni las kyang yin
source_row.english: In them, Three are paths, seven deeds as well.

spans.rationale: Demonstrative refers anaphorically to the ten actions just discussed; English them supplies that referent. It is not a new participant.
Standalone locative LA supplies In in the introductory frame. Preserve the capitalized source English.
The number names the three mental actions, whose path status is explained in364. It is not an absent outline ordinal.
The path noun supplies paths in the first predicate. Its plural is ordinary English inflection; no separate plural null is fabricated.
The number names the seven physical/verbal actions in the second clause. Neighboring364 confirms this referent, without adding that prose here.
Here LAS is the action/deed noun, not an ablative particle. The complete curated record and following explanation establish that lexical sense.
The additive particle says those seven are deeds as well as paths. The complete local additive phrase is as well, with no supplied verb included.

omissions.reason: NI marks the second number/topic, and final YIN explicitly closes the seven-deeds predication. English has are after Three and ellipsis after seven. Assigning that sole are to final YIN would choose between shared scope and translated ellipsis without a secure local atom. Neither topic punctuation nor the copula is treated as an absence null.

The sole explicit copula belongs textually to Three are paths, while the source final YIN follows seven deeds as well. The full verse meaning is coherent, but this compressed correspondence stays unbanked pending independent judgment.
